page.content:
1951 fix-up of the early Foundation stories.

How Foundation (book) connects

  • Creator: Isaac Asimov — Asimov wrote the stories collected as Foundation.
  • Topic: Foundation — The 1951 book is the opening volume of Foundation.
  • Character: Hari Seldon — The first book opens with Hari Seldon and the trial.
  • Work: Foundation and Empire — Foundation and Empire follows the first book.
  • Character: Gaal Dornick — Gaal Dornick is the first book's viewpoint mathematician.
  • Character: Salvor Hardin — Salvor Hardin carries the first book's Terminus crises.
  • Series: Foundation (Apple series) — The books were adapted into the Apple series.
  • Series: Foundation (Apple series) — The Apple series is adapted from Asimov's Foundation.

What is Foundation (book)?

Foundation collects the opening stories: Seldon, Gaal Dornick, the Encyclopedia Galactica, Terminus, and the first crises Salvor Hardin and Hober Mallow meet.

Key threads lead to Isaac Asimov, Foundation, Hari Seldon, Foundation and Empire, Gaal Dornick and Salvor Hardin.
